{{Quote|Captain, seriously, I admire your persistence but this is ridiculous.|Skavak to the future Voidhound|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], towards the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who would become known as the [[Voidhound]] and their associate [[Corso Riggs]] traveled to the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to '''hunt down''' the criminal [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]], whom they had several scores to settle. They met with Coruscant [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] and informant [[Darmas Pollaran]], who utilized his [[Darmas Pollaran's informant network|network]] of informants to help them.
